q: Which Ukrainian club knocked Feyenoord out of Champions League qualifying in August 2012?
note: Confirmed: Dynamo Kyiv knocked Feyenoord out of the Champions League third qualifying round in August 2012, losing both legs.

q: Ajax and PSV met for the first time in April 1931. What was the score?
note: Confirmed: first meeting 12 April 1931, Ajax 4-2.

q: The mayors of Amsterdam and Rotterdam banned away fans from the Klassieker in February 2009. For how long?
note: Confirmed: the February 2009 agreement banned away fans from the fixture for five seasons.

q: Feyenoord beat Ajax 6-0 in April 2024. What record did that set?
a: It was Ajax's biggest defeat of the whole Eredivisie era
note: Confirmed: 7 April 2024, the heaviest defeat Ajax have taken in the Eredivisie. Written about a finished match, so it is not a live-record row.

q: In 2011 Johan Cruyff took Ajax, his own club, to court. What was he so angry about?
a: He had not been told the board was making Louis van Gaal chief executive
sub: The judge agreed and voided the appointment.
note: Confirmed: Cruyff sued over the appointment of Van Gaal as CEO and the judge voided it in February 2012.

q: Which Ajax goalkeeper scored a penalty to complete an 8-1 win over De Graafschap in 1997-98?
note: Confirmed: the only goal of Van der Sar's 606-game career, a penalty in the 8-1 over De Graafschap in 1997-98.

q: Ajax retired the number 14 in Johan Cruyff's honour in 2007. What did Cruyff himself say about it?
a: That the club should let its best player wear it
note: Confirmed: Cruyff laughed it off and said the club should let its best player wear the 14.

q: PSV have retired two shirt numbers. The 12 belongs to the fans. Who has the 99?
note: Confirmed: PSV retire 12 for the supporters and 99 for the mascot Phoxy.

q: Which Brabant singer has filled PSV's Philips Stadion with concerts every summer since 2006?
note: Confirmed: Guus Meeuwis has played the stadium every year since 2006.

q: For decades a playing contract at PSV came with something extra attached. What was it?
note: Confirmed: a playing contract at PSV always came with a Philips job as well.

q: An Eros Ramazzotti concert in 1994 put PSV's board off staging events for years. What had gone wrong?
a: The crowd trampled the pitch to ruin
note: Confirmed: the crowd trampled the pitch at the 1994 Ramazzotti concert, which put the board off events for years.

q: A gorilla that escaped from Rotterdam zoo in 2007 became an unofficial Feyenoord mascot. What was he called?
note: Confirmed on the Dutch article: Bokito escaped from Diergaarde Blijdorp in May 2007 and grew into an unofficial mascot.

q: In 2013 Feyenoord's shirt carried a Rotterdam attraction that was short of money. Which one?
sub: Its elephant Olli became an unofficial mascot.
note: Confirmed: ASR handed the shirt to Diergaarde Blijdorp from January to June 2013, and the elephant Olli became a mascot.

q: How are Feyenoord's new signings delivered onto the pitch at the club's traditional open day?
note: Confirmed on the Dutch article: a helicopter lands on the pitch at the open day to deliver the new signings.
